children: The Nikkei Stock Average falls 0.7% to 64480.14 amid lingering worry over the artificial-intelligence boom amid elevated bond yields worldwide. "Concerns over AI-related investment and credit risks persist," Commerzbank Research analysts say in a research report. French government bond yields climbed on Monday as "violent protests in France over the weekend heightened concerns about the government's ability to address its fiscal deficit," the analysts say. Among worst performers on Japan's benchmark index, Fujikura falls 3.4%, SoftBank Group drops 3.3%, and Resona Holdings sheds 2.7%. The dollar is at 158.51 yen versus Y158.10 around Monday's Tokyo market close. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
